steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize Ludo Classic app project structure and metadata.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up the AndroidManifest.xml with native orientation lock and material theme.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build
steps.description: Configure the build.gradle file with standard compilation SDK versions and clean dependencies.

steps.title: Implement Coordinate System
steps.description: Design the Ludo cell and board path system for the 4 players.

steps.title: Build Board Drawing Logic
steps.description: Program custom onDraw method to render the 15x15 Ludo board grid, starting zones, and safe stars on Canvas.

steps.title: Implement Token Stack Offset Rendering
steps.description: Implement overlapping token offset calculations to allow multiple tokens on the same cell to render distinctively.

steps.title: Implement Touch Interaction and Movement Logic
steps.description: Program touch listener on the canvas board to detect which token of the current player was clicked.

steps.title: Define Game Engine State
steps.description: Implement player turns, token positions, winner checking, and safe zones rules.

steps.title: Fix Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Correct layout positioning errors by replacing invalid 'layout_centerY' attributes with 'layout_centerVertical' in the RelativeLayout header.

steps.title: Implement Dice Rolling Animation
steps.description: Create a handler-based dice roll animation displaying rolling dice faces.

steps.title: Integrate Game Sound and Visual Effects
steps.description: Add Toast feedbacks and visual updates for special game triggers (capture, win, extra turn, six rolled).

steps.title: Implement State Persistence
steps.description: Save game states locally using SharedPreferences to preserve unfinished match status on app exit.

steps.title: Building Ludo Classic
steps.description: Build the debug APK using Gradle tool chain.
